title: Resizable panels
description: Panels side by side or stacked with handles to resize them (an editor beside a preview, a list beside details). Sizes are percentages and can be remembered.
when: Tools where people tune the space between two or three areas.

instead.need: A collapsible tool panel beside a canvas

a11y: Each handle is a focusable separator with aria-valuenow; ←/→ (↑/↓ when stacked) resize, Shift for bigger steps.
